pages.text: The olives had ripened to black. Today the whole family was picking olives.
Lulu spread a net beneath the tree. "I'm going to fill my net." Lulu got a little wooden comb ready too.
Uncle Nino strode over. "Who needs a comb? I'm the best at shaking trees!"
Uncle grabbed a thick branch and shook it hard. Rustle, rustle!
Only leaves fell into the net. Uncle's head was piled with leaves too.
"Ahem! Once more!" Uncle shook even harder.
This time, Uncle's hat got caught on a branch. The olives were still hanging where they had been.
Lulu gently combed a low branch.
Plip, plop! Olives fell into the net. Beside Lulu, the cousins each picked up a comb.
Olives piled up in Lulu's net. Uncle's hat was still hanging in the tree. Everyone laughed.
